svg.title: Uno R3 LM35 Analog Temperature Input

g.text: The example connects VOUT to Uno A0 and uses AVCC as the ADC reference.

g.desc: The example connects VOUT to Uno A0 and uses AVCC as the ADC reference.

g.text: This single-supply circuit is intended for positive temperature readings. KiCad ERC/net checks pass; physical behavior is unverified.

g.desc: This single-supply circuit is intended for positive temperature readings. KiCad ERC/net checks pass; physical behavior is unverified.

g.text: J1 uses logical connections: 1 = LM35 VS, 2 = VOUT, 3 = GND. The connector is not the sensor package pin layout.

g.desc: J1 uses logical connections: 1 = LM35 VS, 2 = VOUT, 3 = GND. The connector is not the sensor package pin layout.

g.text: Check the exact LM35 package drawing and viewing direction in its data sheet before wiring.

g.desc: Check the exact LM35 package drawing and viewing direction in its data sheet before wiring.

g.text: C1 is the local 100 nF supply bypass; keep it close to the sensor.

g.desc: C1 is the local 100 nF supply bypass; keep it close to the sensor.
